findings.name: search-web
findings.root_cause: The liveness probe runs a busy-loop (300k iterations) before wget with only 1s timeout, so it always times out; kubelet kills the healthy container and restarts it in CrashLoopBackOff — the app itself logs no errors because it is not failing.
findings.fix: Remove the busy-loop from the liveness probe command (just 'wget -q -O /dev/null http://127.0.0.1/') or raise timeoutSeconds to at least ~5s; optionally also raise the 10m CPU limit which throttles any probe work.

diagnosis.summary: search-web crash-loops with exit code 0 and no app errors: its liveness probe runs a 300k-iteration busy loop before wget, and with timeoutSeconds=1 it always times out ('Liveness probe failed: command timed out ... after 1s', count 8). Kubelet then kills the running container, causing repeated clean-exit restarts. Fix belongs in the Deployment's livenessProbe spec. Secondary: the 10m CPU limit would also starve even a correct probe."
